en.title: How to Thrive in Code Review in the Age of AI
en.hook: Before AI takes over code reviews, learn the essential skills and practical tips every human reviewer needs to stay relevant.
key_takeaways: Differentiating yourself as a reviewer (high-level thinking, domain expertise)
Automating and optimizing the review workflow

zh.title: 在AI时代如何在代码审查中生存
